messages:
mira: Quick UX/q for the "Delete API key" modal copy. Security wants clearer outcomes and screen-reader friendliness. current secondary is 'Cancel' 

 tom: paste current? 

 mira: Title: Delete API key?
Body: This will remove the key from your account.
Primary: Delete
Secondary: Cancel 

 lee: That's ambiguous. Recommend primary = 'Delete API key' and secondary = 'Keep key' (more descriptive than Cancel). Also add a short consequence line: 'Deleting revokes access immediately; integrations using this key may stop.' 

 security-bot: Automated guidance: confirmation dialogs for destructive actions should state immediate effect and next steps. Use explicit button labels and ensure aria-labels match visible text. 

 tom: For a11y, avoid single-word buttons. aria-labels should be "Delete API key" and "Keep key". Also expose tooltip text via aria-describedby. 

 mira: Proposed final copy:
Title: "Delete API key?"
Body: "Deleting this key revokes access immediately. You may need to update integrations that rely on it."
Primary: "Delete API key" (aria-label="Delete API key")
Secondary: "Keep key" (aria-label="Keep key")
Tooltip: "Deletes the key and revokes access immediately. This cannot be undone." (also in aria-describedby) 

 lee: Add a small link under the body: 'Learn how to rotate keys' -> /docs/keys#rotate. That gives users an action. 

 tom: Analytics: rename cancel event to 'keep_key_clicked' to avoid ambiguous 'cancel' labels. I'll update event mapping. 

 mira: Dev note from security: ensure UI blocks deletion of system-managed keys and log deletion events server-side for audit. 

 design-bot: Checklist: update DS modal variant, run axe on modal, confirm ESC still closes modal and maps to secondary action, update unit tests for analytics name. 

 mira: Action owners: mira -> update DS copy and screenshot; tom -> analytics rename; lee -> accessibility review and doc link; security team -> audit logging check. I'll post screenshots when ready. Thanks!
